desc:
Leeuwarden is a Dutch roleplay game where you can experience all sorts of immersive roleplay scenario's. Do you want to play the game as a civilian or become a criminal? Will you be a police officer, firefighter or paramedic?

🎮We advise all console players to either play the game with voicechat or join the communications server below to communicate with others in the Roleplay voice channel. 

⚠️Please note: All game passes and purchases made within and/or for Leeuwarden are non-refundable.

📶Taggs: Nederlandse Roleplay, Nederland, Politie, Brandweer, Ambulance, Dutch, Netherlands, Roleplay
